title: Worthless junk made out of aluminum
text: Worthless junk made out of aluminum. Find a steel hook, these things are junk and mine bent right over unlike the steel ones I got from my grandma's house years ago. I just needed a couple more. Great if you're only going to put a hat on it but heavy coats and overalls forget it
